# The package an openapi: import writes, run against the local server the
# script harness runs at 127.0.0.1:47819 (cmd/sngl/httpserver_test.go) on
# every target.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout '4 tests, 0 failures'
stderr 'import "openapi:./pokeapi.yml": field evolution_chain of PokemonSpeciesDetail is left out: a map of any value'

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout '4 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout '4 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout '4 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin app.sngl
stdout '4 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout '4 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
// The package an openapi: import writes, run against the local server: a
// function called from a test with server set for it, a 404 classified, a
// query written from a function's parameters, and the adapter component
// asking again when its key changes.

import async "sngl:async"
import poke "openapi:./pokeapi.yml"
import . "sngl:test"
import . "sngl:ui"

const local = "http://127.0.0.1:47819"

func testRetrieve(t Test) {
    t.setContext(poke.server, local)
    match var p = poke.pokemonRetrieveCall(id="bulbasaur") {
        ok {
            t.assert(p.id == 1)
            t.assert(p.baseExperience == 64)
            t.assert(p.types.length() == 2)
            t.assert(p.types[1].type.name == "poison")
            t.assert(p.sprites.frontDefault == "https://example.com/1.png")
            t.assert(p.stats[0].baseStat == 45)
        }
        failed { t.assert(p.message == "") }
    }
}

func testNotFound(t Test) {
    t.setContext(poke.server, local)
    match var f = poke.pokemonRetrieveCall(id="missingno") {
        ok { t.assert(false) }
        failed {
            t.assert(f.kind == async.FailureKind.request)
            t.assert(f.code == "404")
        }
    }
}

func testListQuery(t Test) {
    t.setContext(poke.server, local)
    match var page = poke.pokemonListCall(limit=2, offset=1) {
        ok {
            t.assert(page.count == 5)
            t.assert(page.results.length() == 2)
            t.assert(page.results[0].name == "ivysaur")
            t.assert(page.next != null)
            t.assert(page.previous != null)
        }
        failed { t.assert(page.message == "") }
    }
}

component pager node {
    var offset = 0
    var page option[poke.PaginatedPokemonSummaryList] = null
    poke.server(local) {
        poke.pokemonList(limit=2, offset=offset, :value=page)
    }
    text #first(value=page != null && page.results.length() > 0 ? page.results[0].name : "-")
    button #more(text="More", @click { offset += 2 })
}

func testAdapterAsksAgain(t Test, c pager) {
    t.wait(func() => c.first.value == "bulbasaur", 5000)
    t.assert(c.first.value == "bulbasaur")
    c.more.click()
    t.wait(func() => c.first.value == "venusaur", 5000)
    t.assert(c.first.value == "venusaur")
}

window {
    pager
}
-- pokeapi.yml --
openapi: 3.1.0
info:
  title: PokéAPI
  version: 2.10.0
servers:
- url: https://pokeapi.co
paths:
  /api/v2/pokemon/:
    get:
      operationId: pokemon_list
      summary: List pokemon
      parameters:
      - name: limit
        required: false
        in: query
        description: Number of results to return per page.
        schema:
          type: integer
      - name: offset
        required: false
        in: query
        description: The initial index from which to return the results.
        schema:
          type: integer
      responses:
        '200':
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/PaginatedPokemonSummaryList'
          description: ''
  /api/v2/pokemon/{id}/:
    get:
      operationId: pokemon_retrieve
      summary: Get pokemon
      parameters:
      - in: path
        name: id
        schema:
          type: string
        description: This parameter can be a string or an integer.
        required: true
      responses:
        '200':
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/PokemonDetail'
          description: ''
  /api/v2/pokemon-species/{id}/:
    get:
      operationId: pokemon_species_retrieve
      summary: Get pokemon species
      parameters:
      - in: path
        name: id
        schema:
          type: string
        required: true
      responses:
        '200':
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/PokemonSpeciesDetail'
          description: ''
components:
  schemas:
    PaginatedPokemonSummaryList:
      type: object
      required:
      - count
      - results
      properties:
        count:
          type: integer
          example: 123
        next:
          type: string
          nullable: true
          format: uri
        previous:
          type: string
          nullable: true
          format: uri
        results:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/PokemonSummary'
    PokemonSummary:
      type: object
      properties:
        name:
          type: string
          maxLength: 200
        url:
          type: string
          format: uri
          readOnly: true
      required:
      - name
      - url
    PokemonDetail:
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          type: integer
          readOnly: true
        name:
          type: string
          maxLength: 200
        base_experience:
          type:
          - integer
          - 'null'
        height:
          type:
          - integer
          - 'null'
        is_default:
          type: boolean
        species:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/PokemonSpeciesSummary'
        sprites:
          allOf:
          - $ref: '#/components/schemas/PokemonSprites'
          readOnly: true
        stats:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/PokemonStat'
          readOnly: true
        types:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/PokemonType'
          readOnly: true
      required:
      - id
      - name
      - species
      - sprites
      - stats
      - types
    PokemonSprites:
      type: object
      properties:
        front_default:
          type:
          - string
          - 'null'
      required:
      - front_default
    PokemonStat:
      type: object
      properties:
        base_stat:
          type: integer
        effort:
          type: integer
        stat:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/StatSummary'
      required:
      - base_stat
      - effort
      - stat
    StatSummary:
      type: object
      properties:
        name:
          type: string
        url:
          type: string
          format: uri
      required:
      - name
      - url
    PokemonType:
      type: object
      properties:
        slot:
          type: integer
        type:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/TypeSummary'
      required:
      - slot
      - type
    TypeSummary:
      type: object
      properties:
        name:
          type: string
        url:
          type: string
          format: uri
      required:
      - name
      - url
    PokemonSpeciesSummary:
      type: object
      properties:
        name:
          type: string
        url:
          type: string
          format: uri
      required:
      - name
      - url
    PokemonSpeciesDetail:
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          type: integer
        name:
          type: string
        evolves_from_species:
          oneOf:
          - $ref: '#/components/schemas/PokemonSpeciesSummary'
          - type: 'null'
        evolution_chain:
          type: object
          additionalProperties: {}
      required:
      - id
      - name
      - evolves_from_species
